page.layout: One page of text. Above the text: running head, then a two-line division heading. Body in one column with a woodcut initial D. No marginal notes. Signature mark at lower right of the text block.

main_text.head: DIALECTICA COENÆ DOMINICAE EXPLI-catio.
main_text.p: Duo illa rerum in cœna Domini-ni propositarū genera bifariam considerantur: Absolutè & Comparatè. Absolutè considerata, tam visibilia elementa, panis & vinum, quàm inuisibilis gratia, hoc est corpus & sanguis Christi, ad substantiarum categoriam pertinent: atque sic nomina sua natiua, prout illis primùm sunt imposita, retinent, & ut propria sibi vendicant.Panis igitur & vinum, corpus item & sanguis Christi, si propriis nominibus appellanda sunt, haud aliter quàm panis panis, vinum vinũ, corpus corpus, sanguis sanguis, dicenda sunt. Comparatè spectata, ad eum rerum ordinem pertinent quæ aliò referûtur: unde cùm mutuã affectionem quandam acquirant, debebant utique noua etiam nomina
main_text.notes: Woodcut initial D joined to "uo" as printed ("Duo"). Hyphenated line-end words "Domi-ni" and "Compa-ratè" and "de-bebant" as printed. "impofita" in the scan uses long s and is copied as "imposita". "elemęta" in the scan is read as "elementa"; the macron above the e is uncertain and could be a printing mark. The running head and page number are read from the scan at 55. The lower-right mark "d.iiii." is taken as the gathering signature.
